question: In a certain code language, ‘SOUL’ is coded as ‘6415’ and ‘LOST’ is coded as ‘6548’. How is ‘U’ coded in the given language?
solution:
The given code language is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/663abc78c2b7f804e3f646e8b13d6b6e5865c4bff93871ff8d204abc75e24a13.png]
